narrative.overview: The app is a tidy, approachable place to study. Pages sit on a pale paper background, content lives on white cards with soft rounded corners, and a single study blue marks what you can act on. Dark mode turns the desk into a quiet night study, slate on deep navy, and keeps the same layout. Density is moderate and text-led. The Kids journey brightens the same desk rather than replacing it. The intended feel for controls is bouncy and playful (owner, 2026-11-04); today's controls are clear and dependable, so that feel is the direction of the SPEC-011 overhaul.
keyCharacteristics: One accent colour, study blue, for action and progress.
White or deep-navy cards on a paper or night background, separated by a thin border and a light shadow.
Generous rounding: cards 16 px, banners 24 px, chips and pills fully round.
System fonts, with Noto Sans Devanagari served by the app for Hindi.
Kids adds warmth (amber, indigo and purple washes, Chip) on top of the same structure.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Study blue is the only interactive colour. Kids colours decorate; they never mark a button or link.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Every text and control pair meets 4.5:1 in light and dark (DC-11). Tints carry backgrounds, never text.

rules.name: The No Tiny Text Rule
rules.body: Nothing a learner must read is under 12 px. A few chips use 11 px today, and the overhaul should raise them.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Depth answers state (hover, focus, open). A surface never gets a heavier shadow just to look important.

dos: Do keep study blue (#2563eb, #1d4ed8 for solid buttons) as the only action colour.
Do give every control a 44 px target and a visible 2 px focus ring.
Do keep Standard and Plain English on the calm desk; brighten only the Kids journey.
Do serve fonts and images from the app's own address, including Noto Sans Devanagari.
Do respect reduced motion: transitions collapse to instant (index.css).
donts: Don't set readable text below 12 px.
Don't use a Kids accent colour for a button or link.
Don't rely on emoji as the only carrier of meaning; the overhaul replaces them with original illustrations.
Don't use upstream course images with third-party logos (the brand blocklist stays in force).
